model.note: The model extracts typed fields and per-field confidence. It never decides compliance, never writes legal prose, and never sets a verdict. Fine-tuning teaches extraction/task behaviour only; all rules live in the rules registry.

output_contract.description: Strict JSON. Extra document keys or extra field keys are schema violations, not data to be passed through.

per_document.fields: map of field name -> typed value
per_document.evidence: map of field name -> {page, bbox, snippet}
